snippet.title: Dinerz - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
🍔 Fire Up the Grill! Dinerz Launches on Steam October 12! 🎉🥳

Wishlist the game now!
🔗 https://store.steampowered.com/app/4513300/Dinerz

Dinerz is a first-person cooking and restaurant management simulator where you build your dream diner.

Expand your menu, upgrade your equipment and grow your business - either solo or in co-op! 👩‍🍳👨‍🍳
